name: OctoberWEEN Special 2018
source:
Jezzy is an aspiring apprentice hoping to become a cum witch like her older sister Abby. Although to do so, she needs to gain magical power.

The only way to accomplish this is to absorb the seed of a slime monster, so the two witches conjure up a low level slime (our protagonist) in order to milk it's seed before the time limit of midnight.
translation:
杰西是一位有抱负的学徒，希望成为像她姐姐艾比一样的精液女巫。虽然要做到这一点，她需要获得魔力。

实现这一目标的唯一方法是吸收史莱姆怪物的种子，因此两个女巫召唤出低级史莱姆（我们的主角），以便在午夜时间限制之前榨取其种子。
